questions.title: Hex beacon
questions.statement: The emergency beacon in STORAGE repeats the bytes 41 4D 4F 4E 47 every few seconds. Decode the hex bytes as ASCII and enter the word.
questions.hint: Each pair of hex digits is one ASCII character: 41 is A.
questions.solutionExplanation: 0x41 A, 0x4D M, 0x4F O, 0x4E N, 0x47 G gives AMONG.

questions.title: Fuel gauge off-by-one
questions.statement: fuel.py should print the sum of all integers read from stdin (one per line), but the last tank is always missing. Fix it.

files.name: fuel.py
files.content:
import sys
vals = [int(x) for x in sys.stdin.read().split()]
total = 0
for i in range(len(vals) - 1):
    total += vals[i]
print(total)

questions.answerFormat: Fix fuel.py so every hidden test passes
questions.hint: Look at the loop bound: which index is never visited?
questions.solutionExplanation: range(len(vals) - 1) skips the last element; iterate over all values.

solutionFiles.fuel.py:
import sys
vals = [int(x) for x in sys.stdin.read().split()]
print(sum(vals))
